title: KRILLKRAFT
description: A sweet n' scary wonderland filled with fiery meteors, toxic waste, abyssal oceans, and prehistoric alien magic...
body:
![KRILLKRAFT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ce43513daf89ff0326e264149da2957e5baa404.png)
### The **ULTIMATE SURVIVAL MODPACK** where _Enhanced Vanilla_ meets *Prehistoric Alien Magic!* 

- I am **ALWAYS** updating and adding to this pack, feels like modern day **CRAZYCRAFT** !
- Only the most creative, polished and over-all best mods available on **FORGE 1.20.1**

# ⋆｡°✩❗ **PLAYTESTERS NEEDED** ❗ ✩°｡⋆
### **KRILLKRAFT** has been a **solo project** for years now, it's time people started yelling at me to fix it! 
- If you'd like to be a part of that, I've created a **DISCORD** linked here:

![DISCORDLOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eab93dac2f2c1f8f32a763432bcfaef3589baa22.png)

# [JOIN KRILLKRAFT HERE](https://discord.gg/vVcArndkDY) 🔥☄️

# 🌌 **KRILLKRAFT'S CORE MODS** 🌌

# 🏃‍♂️ [ParCool!](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) 🏃‍♀️
- **KRILLKRAFT** is heavily focused on **EXPLORATION** and **LOOTING**, so I fixed you some **upgraded movement** 
- The mod is preconfigured to **disable** abilities I deem **unnecessary** for casual gameplay (Press **K** in-game to view keybinds)

![PARCOOL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/704d55adb1e32947d2db8827d3b330febdfdf01d.webp)

# 🧬 [SPECIES](https://modrinth.com/mod/species) 🧬
- Have you ever wanted more fictional, made-up mobs that fit well inside the base game? Species is a mod that does exactly that! 
- **Reda**, **Ninni**, **Noon**, **GLaDOS edition** and **Bornulhu** have joined forces to come up and add all sorts of creatures and critters made with tender love and care ~
- Here's a [link](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEd0SRSGI4YZNN0DqAPesPPwLdSmGYRZF) to listen to the Species OST on youtube, be sure to check out the original creators and support them, they did an amazing job!

# 🐾 [SPAWN](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod) 🐾
- Spawn is a mod that adds more animals to the game, and with them new blocks, mechanics and even biomes! 
- Expect **all** kinds of critters from small to big now roaming your Minecraft world

# 🐉 [OPPOSING FORCE](https://modrinth.com/mod/opposing-force) 🐉
- Opposing Force is an enemy mod that focuses on adding unique, fair and challenging enemies to your world, along with a variety of miscellaneous features!
- A major change Opposing Force will bring to your world is the introduction of a Post-Nether and Post-End progression gate

# 🦎 [UNUSUAL PREHISTORY 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/unusual-prehistory-2) 🦎
- To begin your journey to resurrect prehistoric plants and animals, you need to find fossils found throughout the world 
- Follow the map and dig down to find a buried fossil! 
- Using a brush, you can find fossils in suspicious blocks around the fossil site. Once you have fossils and machine parts, you can craft a transmogrifier to revive extinct dinos!

</details>
